content.title: MCW Q3 Deep Dive: Membership and Pricing Drive Growth Amid Easing Competition
content.summary: Conveyorized car wash service company Mister Car Wash (NYSE:MCW) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.7% year on year to $263.4 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $1.05 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.11 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
